content: {"reasoning": "The CO-197 denial is for missing prior authorization at time of service. This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those routes are closed. Resubmitting as-is or with records won't cure a genuine auth gap, and there is no data error to correct. The only remaining legitimate path to challenge the denial and progress toward collection is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, which is valid since a denial is on the table.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
